issues.message: No connection to the script. Check the Web App URL — 6× in the last 7 days
issues.detail: Last at 15 Nov 15:30 · from Windows browser

steps: In Apps Script for the Finance app, open Deploy → Manage deployments and copy the Web app URL (ends in /exec).
On the device named below, open Finance → Settings → Sync, paste that URL and save.
Tap Sync now. Once it saves successfully this problem turns into "recovered" on its own.

issues.message: Account "Study Loan" shows amount owed as negative (-9800)
issues.detail: Other debts are positive. Use one sign for "Owed" so totals add up. Row 10

steps: In Finance → Accounts, edit this account and enter the amount owed as a positive number.
All debts should use the same sign so totals and net worth add up.

issues.message: 2 transaction(s) in the last 90 days have no category

steps: Open the rows to find them, then give each transaction a category in Finance.

issues.message: 1 transaction(s) use account "Old Wallet", which is not in the Accounts tab

steps: Either add this account in Finance → Accounts,
or edit these transactions to use the right existing account.

issues.message: Category written 2 ways: 🍽️ Food & Drinks · 🍔 Food & Drinks

steps: In Finance → Categories, keep one version and merge the other into it (the link opens a transaction that uses the rarer one).
If there is no merge option, edit the category's icon so both match.

issues.message: 1 positive amount(s) in spending category "🍜 Food" in the last 30 days
issues.detail: Refund, or is the sign wrong? e.g. 2026-11-15 RM 232.00 on Aeon Bank (row 110)

steps: Open the row. If it is a refund, that is fine: hide this problem.
If it is income or a transfer, change its category in Finance (e.g. Income or Transfer). If the sign is wrong, edit the amount.

issues.message: Payslip 2026-08-25: Gross − Deductions ≠ Net

steps: Open the row and check the figures against the payslip PDF, then correct them in Finance.

issues.message: Gold price failed: Failed to fetch — 4× in the last 7 days
issues.detail: Last at 14 Nov 12:03 · from Windows browser

steps: Maybank blocks the price check when it runs from the browser, so it fails every time.
Lasting fix: move the gold price fetch into the Finance app's Apps Script (ask Claude). Until then, enter the gold price by hand.

issues.message: Date saved as "0021-03-02" (typo year) — reading it as 2021-03-02
issues.detail: row 10. Re-save this entry in Garage to fix the stored date.

steps: The year was stored wrongly (e.g. 0021 instead of 2021). The dashboard reads it correctly, but the app may not.
In Garage, open that entry, pick the date again from the date picker and save.

issues.message: 2 _Log entr(ies) record only a date, without the time
issues.detail: Some clients write "11/15/2026" instead of a full timestamp. Write ISO timestamps everywhere (see CONVENTIONS.md).

steps: This is in Flow's code, not your data: some devices log only the date.
Ask Claude to change Flow to write full timestamps. It does no harm meanwhile.

issues.message: Tab "Sheet1" is empty and can be deleted

steps: In the Finance tracker sheet, right-click the empty tab → Delete.

issues.message: Similar categories "🍜 Food" and "🍽️ Food & Drinks" — merge?

steps: Decide whether these are really different. If not, merge them in Finance → Categories.
If they are meant to be different, hide this problem.

issues.message: 1 possible duplicate transaction(s) in the last 60 days

steps: Open the rows and compare them with your bank statement.
Delete the extra copy in Finance. If both are real (two identical purchases), hide this problem.

issues.message: 3 balance adjustments this month (net RM -66.35)
issues.detail: Frequent adjustments mean some spending is not being recorded.

steps: Each adjustment means the app and the bank disagreed. Look for the spending you missed on the statement.
Record it as normal transactions next time instead of adjusting the balance. This clears at the start of next month.

issues.message: Service item "Wiper blades" is used in 1 log(s) but is not in the service list

steps: In Garage, add "Wiper blades" to the service list (Settings → Service items),
or edit the log to use an item that is already in the list.

issues.message: 1 deleted row(s) are still stored in the sheet

steps: Harmless: deleted entries are kept so other devices learn about the deletion.
Optional tidy-up: in the sheet, filter the "deleted" column for "yes" and delete those rows.
